name: Michigan MHSAA Lower Peninsula Cross Country Finals
headline: Michigan MHSAA Lower Peninsula Cross Country Finals
summary: Ann Arbor Pioneer's girls are No. 4 in DyeStat's national team rankings and Pioneer's Natasza Dudek is the No. 1 girl in the country. Whitehall's Robert Jazwinski III is No. 6 among boys. All four divisions race at MIS.
